label: A subclass factor/truth gap is at most the aggregate gap divided by the subclass weight
paraphrase: For every measure on cases, verdicts of any type and measurable class S of cases, the factor/truth gap conditioned on S is at most the aggregate gap divided by the measure of S. An aggregate bound e2 therefore bounds the gap within a class of weight w only by e2/w, which exceeds e2 whenever w < 1 and gives no information once w ≤ e2.
